name: LocalyticsX.Builder.autoIntegrate
author: akano12
description: Localytics (Upland) collects analytics and the location for the app. Right after the app integrates it, it opts out with its own switches, setOptedOut and setPrivacyOptedOut, and the app cannot opt in again or enable location monitoring. Install all Localytics definitions. For Localytics 6 and later (com.localytics.androidx).

-- Localytics opts out, with its own switches, of collecting data and of its privacy data, right after the app
-- integrates it; the hooks of setOptedOut and setPrivacyOptedOut keep the app from opting in again.
-- The package of the class of the hook, com.localytics.android before version 6, com.localytics.androidx after.
function after(hook, param)
    if param:getException() ~= nil then
        return false
    end
    local package = string.match(hook:getClassName(), '^(.*)%.')
    local localytics = param:findClass(package .. '.Localytics')
    localytics:setPrivacyOptedOut(true)
    localytics:setOptedOut(true)
    return true
end
